clc_revision.description: CLC language revision the vector declares (§12.1). A revision outside the implementation's compatible range MUST resolve to deny('unsupported_language_revision') — fail-closed, no silent downgrade.

conformance_class.description: Conformance class exercised by the vector (all vectors are 'CLC-A'; no structural-beware evidence vectors exist yet, so there is no CLC-B/C today).

raw_params.description: Raw JSON object text of the request (operation) params, for inputs whose meaning cannot survive a decoded map: duplicate JSON keys, non-finite or over-precision numbers, and size/depth overruns. Runners MUST validate this at the input boundary (§6.2.1, §9.3 layer 2) and short-circuit to deny(<code>) when invalid.

grant.description: Grant under test. null = no grant available; {} = empty grant record. Both are legitimate fail-closed inputs and MUST resolve to deny("capability_not_authorized") per CLC-v1 §9 (layer 10). For kind=intersect, `null` with no `others` is the zero-source case of §7 rule 5 and MUST resolve to deny("absent_source").

request.description: Operation under test (for entail/decide vectors). An operation with no `id` ({} or an omitted field) is a legitimate fail-closed input and MUST resolve to deny("missing_capability_id") per CLC-v1 §9.3 layer 1.

result_params.description: For kind=intersect: the merged grant's params. Runners MUST compare this — a runner that only compares the verdict is not conforming.

result_constraints.description: For kind=intersect: the merged grant's constraints (order-insensitive).
